Aspen Acres, Custer County. CIMT (RM Team 3). Twenty miles southwest of Pueblo, CO. Timber. Minimal 
fire behavior with backing, creeping and smoldering. Numerous structures and communication infrastructure 
threatened. Area and road closures in effect. 
 
Gold Mountain, Grand Mesa, Uncompahgre and Gunnison NF, USFS. CIMT (RM Team 1). CIMT is also 
managing the Elk incident. Two miles north of Ouray, CO. Grass, brush and timber. Minimal fire behavior with 
creeping, torching and smoldering. Numerous structures and critical infrastructure threatened. Area, road and 
trail closures in effect. 
 
Elk, Grand Mesa, Uncompahgre and Gunnison NF, USFS. Seven miles northwest of Lake City, CO. Timber, 
brush and grass. Minimal fire behavior with creeping, torching and smoldering. Area, road and trail closures in 
effect. 
 
Rio Blanco, San Juan NF, USFS. Ten miles south of Pagosa Springs, CO. Timber, brush and grass. Active 
fire behavior with short-range spotting, isolated torching and backing. Numerous structures threatened. Area 
and road closures in effect. 
 
* Left Creek, Crook County. One mile southwest of Devils Tower, WY. Timber. Moderate fire behavior with 
smoldering and creeping. Structures threatened. Evacuations, area, road and trail closures in effect. 
 
Willow, Pike and San Isabel NF, USFS. Six miles west of Leadville, CO. Brush, closed timber litter and timber. 
Minimal fire behavior with single tree torching, creeping and smoldering. Residences threatened. Area, road 
and trail closures in effect. 
 
Lumin, Sheridan County. Twenty-two miles east of Sheridan, WY. Grass and brush. Minimal fire behavior. 
Residences threatened.
